What it is

Build prompt

Build a dark split signup. Page #050505, centered 960px panel split 55/45, 20px radius, 16px gap. Left: artwork of a cupped hand under a floating plasma orb - CSS/shader version: black canvas, a 200px sphere = layered radial gradients (white-hot core top-left, steel blue mid, transparent rim) + 2 rotating ember wisps (orange blurred crescents, rotate 8s opposite directions) + faint god-rays (conic-gradient streaks at 4% opacity, slow sweep); hand silhouette dark with rim light from the orb (top-down gradient). Right: 'Sign up for free' eyebrow, 'Join SoundCore AI' 22px semibold, white 'Sign up with Google' button, divider, 3 dark inputs (#111, 1px white/10, focus ring white/30), white 'Start Building' pill, muted legal line. All motion confined to the orb panel.
